line_items.reasoning: No specific Q1 CapEx figures were reported to compare against the 2025 full-year guidance of $265M–$285M; results neither explicitly confirmed nor contradicted the guided range.

Gross margin fell 40 bps YoY to 45.1% in Q1 2025, driven by product/customer mix, higher third-party freight costs, and elevated hub vehicle lease costs — contrary to guidance that Q4 product margin pressures would not recur and gross margin would be roughly flat YoY.

Operating margin declined 50 bps YoY to 20.1% despite 5% DSR growth, falling short of the guided high-end incremental operating leverage of 20%–25% that was expected to materialize with mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth.

Digital footprint reached only 61% of sales in Q1 2025, well below the 66%–68% full-year target, and while FMI device count grew 12.5% YoY, no specific MAU signing progress toward the 28,000–30,000 goal was confirmed, suggesting the digital footprint target is tracking behind pace.
